A Loaded Axe blessed with Ancient Dragons' Lightning.
Costs Spirit Emblems to use.

A Prosthetic Tool loaded with the feather of a Mist Raven.  Costs Spirit Emblems to use.

When attacked in the assumed stance, disappear like the mist and move away.

Once you think you've caught one, all that will remain is feathers.
That is the mark of a true Mist Raven.
(Use without obligation.)

A Loaded Spear with a spiral chiseled into the blade with Ancient Dragons' Lightning.
Costs Spirit Emblems to use.

Sharp thrust attacks from this Prosthetic Tool damage an enemy's Vitality and Posture, even through their guard.

The spear's spiral creates a corkscrew shockwave that gouges and rends as it penetrates.

Costs Spirit Emblems to use.

This technique binds all enemies, turning all enemies into allies for a period of time.
A puppet moves on behalf of its master, but its strings will inevitably break.

<?kgiconKc@17?>: Ancient Dragon Lightning Strike
Swing the heavy Ancient Dragon Lightning axe downward, causing a sound shockwave that dispels illusions.

Hold <?kgiconKc@17?>: Ancient Dragon Lightning Scythe
Whirl the heavy Ancient Dragon Lightning axe around
in circles to strike enemies.
Pressing <?kgiconKc@17?> during Ancient Dragon Lightning Scythe will
cause one to whirl again, continuing the attack.

<?kgiconKc@17?>: Mist Stance
When attacked in this stance, instantly move in the direction chosen with <?kgMove?>.

<?kgiconKc@17?>: Ancient Dragon Lightning Thrust
Release a spinning corkscrew thrust at an enemy before you.
This will damage their Vitality and Posture, even if guarded.

<?kgiconKc@17?>→<?kgiconKc@17?>: Drag
Pull an enemy struck by the spear back towards you.  Can also tear poorly-fitting armor from heavier foes.

Hold <?kgiconKc@17?>: Corkscrew Rush
Ready your spear and unleash a keen, spinning corkscrew rush.
